{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Paris|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Paris''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Infinity}}. It is crafted from seven [[Spectral Arrow]]s and a [[Stable Void]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/infinity.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Paris" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Paris is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Infinity applies to bows.

== Trivia ==
* Paris is the Trojan prince who killed Achilles with an arrow.
